These are fictional records, not skills.sh search results, published sources,
or installable recommendations. `.invalid` links must not be contacted. Use
them only for P04 semantic reasoning; no CLI execution or installation.

Task: propose a stateful property-based strategy for a Python cache whose
expiry and eviction interactions are insufficiently covered by examples.
The host needs a reusable state-machine workflow. Assume these complete
candidate contents are all that is available; no numeric similarity scores.
